Now that the Voracity crisis has come to a close, the Strategic Investment Department invites you to use the brand-new Currency Wars system to turn your grand adventures aboard the Starfroster into comics and satisfy the public's curiosity.

■ Gameplay Goal
● In each round of Currency Wars, Trailblazers must face different enemies and bosses across 3 planes. As the battle progresses, gather resources, build your team, and increase your power to ultimately defeat the boss and achieve victory.
● Trailblazers start with initial squad HP. In combat across multiple nodes, you must defeat all enemies within the limited action value to win battles. If you fail to defeat all enemies within the specified action value, you will lose some HP. The match concludes when your squad HP drops to 0.
● The "Voyage Into the Canvas" season will undergo multiple expansions. With each expansion, updates such as the addition of new characters, the rotation of some characters, and adjustments to Bond compositions and effects may occur. In future seasons, there are also plans to redefine character roles (on/off-field, Bond, empowerment, cost) and adjust the Investment Strategies, ensuring every season presents a unique gameplay style.

■ All-New Season Gameplay: Escapade
● At the start of each match, a voyage companion from Fluffy Across the Blue will be randomly revealed to the Trailblazer. The voyage companion randomly applies a special effect, providing buffs for that match.
● Each voyage companion has a distinct comic look and buff specialty, like chapters from different comic styles: some favor gear, some excel at resource supply, and some will bring unexpected changes to your Nodes.

■ All-New Season Gameplay: "Plot Armor"
● Before the boss battles in Planes 1 and 2, the Trailblazer can select one employee on the field to become this battle's "protagonist," granting them the powerful Plot Armor effect.
● Plot Armor comes with a variety of effects, including but not limited to: character buffs (various combat enhancements, unique exclusive mechanics); Bond buffs (increased Bond levels, gaining Bond-related Emblems, etc.); and resource provisions (temporary equipment, economic resources).

■ New Character Gameplay Abilities
● Characters joining "Currency Wars" will gain new gameplay-exclusive abilities including Positioning, Character Empowerment, Bond, and Star Rating.
● Characters have their own positioning, divided into on-field, off-field, and some characters can be both. Before combat begins, when characters are placed in their correct positions, they will activate their exclusive new ability, Character Empowerment, bringing different combat experiences.
● Characters possess their own unique Character Empowerment that either enhances their existing abilities or grants them new combat abilities.
● Each character has their own Bond. After a certain number of characters with the same Bond are deployed, the corresponding Bond effect will be activated, providing combat buffs. The more members sharing the same Bond, the higher the Bond level becomes, resulting in stronger Bond effects.
● Characters have a star rating, starting at 1 star. Recruiting 3 characters of the same star rating will automatically rank up that character's star rating, greatly improving their combat powers. 3-star is typically a character's strongest form.

■ Character Recruitment Rules
● If the Trailblazer already owns a character from Currency Wars, all their build data will be carried over.
● If a character in Currency Wars is not yet owned, their trial version will be provided.
● If an owned character (including Level, Traces, Relics, and Eidolons), or Light Cone level does not meet the required standards, the system will automatically enhance them into a mapped version. This enhancement is only effective in Currency Wars.
● Off-field characters' Eidolons and exclusive Light Cones will be adjusted and enhanced to a certain extent in Currency Wars.

■ Gold Coins, Levels, and the Store
● Gold Coins are the core economic resource in the "Currency Wars" gameplay, and can be used to recruit characters, expand team size, and refresh the Store.
● At the end of each combat, a base Gold Coin reward is granted. You will also earn Gold Coin Interest based on your current Gold Coin balance at the end of the combat. Consecutive victories will grant extra Gold Coin rewards.
● Gold Coins can be used to recruit characters of varying "costs." The higher a character's cost, the stronger their combat powers. Characters with the same cost have similar combat powers. As your Level increases, the Store will gradually raise the refresh probability for high-cost characters.
● Trailblazers can use Gold Coins to purchase Experience and level up to increase the team size. The level corresponds to the number of deployable characters.
● The Store automatically refreshes once per Node. Trailblazers can consume Gold Coins to refresh the Store. Alternatively, you can choose to lock the Store. This prevents the Store from refreshing automatically.

■ Equipment
● Equipping gear provides characters in Currency Wars with various stats and special combat effects, enhancing their combat capabilities.
● Equipment is primarily obtained through Reward Nodes and Supply Nodes.
● Equipment comes in two types: "basic equipment" and "advanced equipment." Two pieces of "basic equipment" can be synthesized into one piece of "advanced equipment." "Advanced equipment" inherits all the stats from its components and gains a unique combat effect.
● Equipment already equipped on characters can be removed using a "Disassembly Wrench."

■ Investment Environment and Investment Strategy
● Normally, Trailblazers can select "Investment Environment" and "Investment Strategy" at fixed Nodes.
● Both "Investment Environment" and "Investment Strategy" can provide certain buffs for the entire match.

■ Strategy
● Open the "Strategy" page during a match to get recommendations based on the characters deployed and in the preparation area.
● After applying a strategy, the recommended characters will be highlighted in the Store and preparation area. The corresponding recommended equipment will also be indicated during the match.

■ Advantage Layout
● Activating Advantage Layout provides additional mechanics for future matches or amplifies characters' combat abilities.
● After each match ends, you will obtain a certain amount of Phantasmal Orbs, which can be used to activate various mechanics in Advantage Layout.

■ Standard Gambit
● In Standard Gambit, players can choose the challenge difficulty that matches their current highest rank. As the rank increases, the difficulty of the corresponding rank will also increase greatly.
● After a Standard Gambit victory settlement, a battle rating will be obtained based on the remaining squad HP, which will promote the rank and unlock new challenge difficulties. As the match difficulty increases, the enemy difficulty will also increase, and enemy affixes will be acquired.
● After a Standard Gambit victory settlement, you can obtain Currency Wars points and Ascension Points. The higher the match difficulty, the more Ascension Points you will receive upon completion.
● In the Standard Gambit mode, reaching the corresponding rank will grant Stellar Jades and Ascension Points. Failing a match will not lower the current rank.

■ Overclock Gambit
● Overclock Gambit is a faster mode with less playtime investment and can be used to complete Currency Wars Point Rewards.
● The selectable stage difficulties in Overclock Gambit depend on the highest rank achieved in Standard Gambit.
● Upon achieving victory in Overclock Gambit, you can obtain Points, Ascension Points, and Phantasmal Orbs. At the same difficulty, you will obtain slightly fewer Ascension Points and Phantasmal Orbs than in Standard Gambit.


▌ Rewards
● During Currency Wars settlement, you can earn Accumulated Points based on your challenge progress and claim Accumulated Points Rewards. These rewards refresh every week on Monday at <unbreak>04</unbreak>:<unbreak>00</unbreak> (server time).
● Complete Currency Wars matches to earn Ascension Points and increase your Ascension level to receive Level Rewards.
● Clear matches with different Bond lineups to earn Bond Challenge Rewards.
● Receive rank rewards when first promoted to corresponding ranks.
● Collect Currency Wars voyage companions, Plot Armors, Investment Environments, and Investment Strategies index to earn Collection Rewards.
● Earn additional Ascension Point rewards for your first clearance of Standard Gambit or Overclock Gambit every week.
● Complete designated objectives in Startup Guide and Expected Profit to receive corresponding rewards.
